This is hymn number 2 titled "The Spirit of God" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in A Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Anonymous and the lyrics were written by William W. Phelps.
This hymn is categorized under: Restoration.
